title: Car loan executive
description:
Car Loan Sales Executive Company: Panobiz Business Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Client: Federal Bank Position: Car Loan Sales Executive Industry: Banking / Financial Services Department: Sales Product:

Car Loan Job Responsibilities \- Generate new car loan leads through open\-market and field sales activities. \- Identify and approach potential customers looking for new or used car loans. \- Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, dealers, and channel partners. \- Explain car loan products, eligibility criteria, interest rates, documentation, and repayment terms to customers. \- Collect and verify customer documents required for loan processing. \- Coordinate with the bank's credit and operations teams for smooth processing of loan applications. \- Follow up with customers from lead generation to loan disbursement. \- Achieve assigned monthly sales targets and business volumes. \- Develop and maintain a strong network of car dealers and other referral sources. \- Generate business through referrals, dealer relationships, and local market visits. \- Maintain accurate records of leads, applications, follow\-ups, and conversions. \- Ensure proper customer service and timely resolution of customer queries. \- Prepare and submit daily/weekly sales reports as required. Key Requirements \- Graduate in any discipline. \- Experience in car loan / auto loan / vehicle finance sales will be preferred. \- Candidates with experience in banking, NBFC, automobile finance, or field sales can also be considered. \- Good communication and interpersonal skills.

\- Strong customer acquisition and relationship\-building skills. \- Ability to work in field sales and achieve targets.

\- Good knowledge of the local market. \- Must be comfortable with travelling for customer and dealer visits.

\- Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period will be preferred.

Salary CTC: As per company norms / based on experience.

Location \-Tirur, Trivandrum, Kozhikode,Kottayam,Attingal,Kollam, palakkad

Employment Payroll: Panobiz Business Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Client: Federal Bank

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kottayam, Kerala
